summary: This bill designates the United States Postal Service facility located at 100 North Taylor Lane in Patagonia, Arizona, as the "Jim Kolbe Memorial Post Office".

scores.thoughts: This bill designates a post office in honor of Jim Kolbe. While there might be a negligible administrative cost associated with updating signage or records, the bill itself does not appropriate funds or significantly alter government spending. The impact is so minimal it approaches zero.
